label: OPEN, analyst formulation of the analogy premise of ST I q.19 a.1, attribution deferred: whatever…
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation of the analogy premise of ST I q.19 a.1, attribution deferred: whatever is in act through a form, natural or intelligible, has some inclination following that form. Inclination is orientation at the level of nature or power, covering seeking an absent good and resting in a possessed one; no current exercise or passivity is asserted.
